The '''Rebel battle armor''', also known as the '''Rebel heavy battle armor''', was a style of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Charge.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rebel troopers, with reinforced armor, with the middle Rebel without a face visor.]]
The Rebel battle armor was developed for light, modern combat and was often worn by a soldier needing to retain their agility. It offered protection against kinetic damage as well as from energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]].<ref name="SWG:CU" /> The armor was designed to help ensure the survival of Rebel infantry during direct confrontation against an overwhelming number of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] troops.<ref name="FiB" /> The complete armor set was composed of the helmet, chest plate, left & right biceps, left & right bracers, gloves, leggings and boots. The helmet itself included a full-face visor, a neck scarf,<ref name="SWG:CU" /> a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] and a respirator.<ref name="FiB" />

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Rebel battle armor was worn by [[Rebel heavy trooper]]s,<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Rebel Heavy Trooper}}</ref> [[Rebel Honor Guard/Legends|Rebel Alliance Honor Guards]],<ref name="SWG:ED">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Remembrance Day}}</ref> [[Rebel Assault Commando]]s,<ref name="SWG:GU15">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Game Update 15: Galactic Civil War: Forces Under Siege</ref> and [[Rebel Desert Trooper]]s.<ref name="SWG:GU17">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Game Update 17: Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII</ref> A battle armor was also used by [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel trooper]] [[Mika Horn]].<ref name="SWG:FWAC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer retrieved the nine parts of a Rebel battle armor while visiting multiple worlds in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and finally assembled the complete armor.<ref name="SWG:LRBA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Rebel Battle Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel battle armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Rebel battle armor was one of the Rebel [[W:c:swg:Faction armor|faction armors]] added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Combat Upgrade|Combat Upgrade]],"<ref name="SonyCite-Combat Upgrade: Armor System">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Combat%20Upgrade:%20Armor%20System|text=Combat Upgrade: Armor System}}</ref> on [[April 27]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
